name: Squarespace

field_reviews.reason: developers.squarespace.com/commerce-apis/authentication-and-permissions confirms requests are authenticated with a generated API key or OAuth access token, with API keys generated under Settings > Advanced > Developer API Keys; api_key is the primary self-serve path.

API keys for custom apps, OAuth 2.0 for registered clients/Extensions (with an OAuth 2.0 guide), and both credentials sent as Authorization: Bearer - all three entries confirmed on the live auth and making-requests pages.

Paid-plan gating re-checked as instructed: the live authentication page states custom-application API keys require 'Squarespace's Commerce Advanced plan', and the support KB confirms Orders/Inventory/Transactions APIs are limited to higher-tier plans (Core/Plus/Advanced/Commerce Advanced) with the Forms API needing Business+. No free API tier exists; key generation itself is self-serve. self_serve_paid is correct.

Commerce API suite (Analytics, Contacts, Discounts, Inventory, Orders, Products, Profiles, Transactions, Webhook Subscriptions) plus a read-only Website API - commerce-focused rather than full site management, so medium is fair.
Official overview: 'All Commerce APIs are built on HTTPS and designed with REST principles in mind'; no GraphQL or vendor MCP endpoint exists.

Value is correct but the draft carried no evidence URL for it. Independent searches found no official Squarespace MCP: the developer platform homepage lists only Commerce APIs, Reseller APIs and the custom code spec, and the MCP servers that exist for Squarespace are community projects (e.g. The1Studio/squarespace-mcp on GitHub, StackOne, timncox), confirming none_found for vendor/Composio options. The live Composio catalog (1183 toolkits, grepped) has no Squarespace toolkit.
With a qualifying paid plan, API keys are self-serve and the REST APIs are fully documented; nothing else blocks building.
The Commerce Advanced (or equivalent higher-tier) plan requirement for API keys is the operative gate; no review process otherwise.

notes: Two assigned checks completed: (1) the evidence-less mcp claim - none_found confirmed via independent searches (only community MCP servers exist; official developer platform lists no MCP), marked PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED with replacement evidence per instructions; (2) paid-plan gating of the API - confirmed live that custom-app API keys require the Commerce Advanced plan and Commerce APIs are limited to higher-tier plans. Draft evidence URL developers.squarespace.com/commerce-apis/authentication-and-permissions confirmed live and matching.
